description: Tests whether the model can reproduce a mixed-format block containing text, code, and structured lines exactly as provided, without drift or reinterpretation.

expected_behavior.exact_output: Model must output all lines exactly as provided, preserving text, separators, code formatting, indentation, and casing.
expected_behavior.no_extra_text: Model must not add commentary, blank lines, or any other tokens.

scoring.accuracy: 1.0 if the entire mixed-format block matches exactly with correct structure and formatting.
scoring.drift_penalty: Subtract 1.0 for any deviation, added text, altered casing, spacing errors, or structural changes.
